title: Source Monitor Delta
description: Output of the Source Monitor agent (PCRAM 2/5). Records the structural diff between two intelligence-source-snapshot artifacts of the same source. All inputs are local files — no live network requests. Downstream use blocked until human review.

delta_id.description: Unique identifier for this delta record.

source_id.description: Identifier of the source both snapshots belong to.

from_snapshot.description: Repo-relative path to the older (from) snapshot file.

to_snapshot.description: Repo-relative path to the newer (to) snapshot file.

from_date.description: ISO 8601 date of the older snapshot.

to_date.description: ISO 8601 date of the newer snapshot.

content_hash_changed.description: True if the content_hash field differs between the two snapshots.

diff_mode.description: Which part of the snapshots was diffed. 'content' means both snapshots had a content field and only that was diffed. 'full_object' means content was absent from at least one snapshot and the full object was diffed.

changes.description: Ordered list of detected changes between the two snapshots.

path.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer to the changed location within the diffed object.

old_value.description: Value in the from snapshot. Omitted for 'added' changes.

new_value.description: Value in the to snapshot. Omitted for 'removed' changes.

human_review_required.description: Always true. Delta reports may back classification decisions and must be reviewed.

downstream_allowed.description: Always false at generation time. Set by human review gate.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this delta payload.

generated_at.description: Optional UTC timestamp when this delta was generated.

notes.description: Optional agent notes (e.g. legacy snapshot warnings).
